items.title: Last season, James Harden drew the most 3P shooting fouls. It was the 10th season in which he led the NBA in that category.
items.author: NBA Stat
items.body_excerpt:
Last season, James Harden drew the most 3P shooting fouls. It was the 10th season in which he led the NBA in that category.

His career regular-season total is now 747, by far the highest total since data became available in 2000–01. Stephen Curry is a distant second with 304.

(via CrazyStats)
